A '''cloudjumper''' was a small [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nason Laric]] used one to travel between the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yabosta]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Skalokor]]. It was able to carry at least two passengers.
